snippet.title: Rotor City: Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Rotor City is a helicopter game that plays in your browser, on any Mac or PC. 

Play it: https://rotor.city/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=launch-trailer

Fourteen helicopters you'll recognise, from the classics to the modern ones and a few from the future. Five living cities. Fires to put out, people to rescue, storms, and oil rigs at night. Build a base, run a fleet, and take the jobs.

Why I made it: it's the helicopter game I lost as a kid, rebuilt. The whole story: https://youtu.be/I3QGHav_a-M

You'll need a computer, not a phone. Your saves stay in your own browser.

Rotor City is an independent game. It isn't affiliated with or endorsed by Electronic Arts, Maxis or any helicopter manufacturer; the helicopters' names are fictional.

#RotorCity #HelicopterGame #IndieGame
